body.prompt: Many years later at the same small red-tarp fish-shaped bread stall in the same snowy market at evening: the same mother now in her seventies with white hair in a low bun, a plum-colored padded coat, slightly bent, the same kind face, arm in arm with her grown-up son in his thirties with short black hair, a navy wool coat and a grey scarf. The son points at the full rack of golden fish-shaped pastries, smiling; the old mother looks at the stall with a nostalgic, surprised face. Warm stall light, gentle snow.
